events.n: the graphic work the lithograph is after
events.q: La Bouteille is an original lithograph after a graphic work first realized by Georges Braque in 1911.
This print is from the portfolio Derrière Le Miroir No. 138 p.7.

events.n: edited by Maeght, printed by Mourlot
events.q: Edited by Maeght and printed by Mourlot in 1963.

events.t: The Complete Prints of Georges Braque. Catalog raisonné
